headline: Fronts Flare as Bases Change Hands Across Six Sectors
war_summary: The war has reached day 260 with the strategic map still largely divided: Colonials control the majority of northern and central hexes, while Wardens hold the southern and western sectors. Contested ground remains limited to a handful of regions where ownership is mixed — Callahans Passage (9 Warden/1 neutral), Farranac Coast (1 Warden/9 Colonial/1 neutral), Fishermans Row (1 Warden/7 Colonial/1 neutral), Stlican Shelf (8 Warden/1 Colonial), Stonecradle (5 Warden/4 Colonial) and Weathered Expanse (4 Warden/3 Colonial/2 neutral). Since the last edition three hours ago, fighting has intensified in six sectors. Weathered Expanse recorded 39 ownership flips in the past 24 hours, adding roughly 10 k Colonial and 13 k Warden casualties with enlistments accelerating. Fishermans Row saw 32 flips and steady casualties, while Farranac Coast logged eight flips and over 8 k losses per side with rising enlistments. Callahans Passage, though only two flips, continues to bleed >19 k casualties each side and shows accelerating recruitment. Stlican Shelf produced 28 flips and ~6 k casualties per faction, also with accelerating enlistments. Godcrofts registered 33 flips but lower casualty counts and modest enlistment growth. Most other fronts remain quiet, reporting no base changes and only incremental losses.
